mapper.select: SELECT dr.id, dr.email, dr.record_date, dr.meal_type, df.id AS diet_food_id, df.diet_id, df.food_id, f.name AS food_name, df.serve_count, df.order_index, f.calories, f.carbohydrate, f.protein, f.fat FROM diet_records dr LEFT JOIN diet_foods df ON dr.id = df.diet_id LEFT JOIN foods f ON df.food_id = f.id WHERE dr.id = #{id} AND dr.email = #{userId} ORDER BY df.order_index
SELECT id, email AS userId, record_date AS recordDate, meal_type AS mealType FROM diet_records WHERE email = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
